body:
**The peak of SLOPPP, and the year Dan sided with Anthony Cumia.**

Two things run through 2014 and they sit badly together. The music project
reaches full professional shape — a Beatport remix contest, official-style
flips for named artists, two running mix series, a live-streamed video show,
stem trades, a public collaboration address, and thanks from other producers.
And in July, at the exact moment the corpus's account of his politics says he
was being repelled, he publicly backed Anthony Cumia over the firing that
started it.

**This year is spreadsheet-backed, which is a different thing from complete.**
Unlike 2009–2013 there is no month-end fetch artefact here — 170 of 171 rows
come from the operator export, and the shape of the page is the shape of the
year. But the export is **not a proven census**: a backend fetch on 2026-09-02
recovered a February 2016 tweet the export had missed
(`wiki/interests/music/overview`), so it can drop rows. Absence on this page is
**good evidence and not conclusive evidence**, and the finding below is built to
survive that: it rests on what he did post, not on what he did not.

## 4 July 2014, and a correction to the corpus's own account

`wiki/interests/opie-and-anthony` and `wiki/mind/synthesis/2020-left-turn` both
rest on a claim Dan made in **2022**:

> *"while many O&A fans followed Anthony down the reactionary rabbit hole of
> white-grievance politics…a lot of the online community were so repulsed by
> the racism and fascistic overtones that we were radicalized to leftist
> politics"*

Anthony Cumia was fired by SiriusXM on **3 July 2014**, after posting a series
of racist messages about a Black woman who had struck him in Times Square. The
next day, Dan tweeted at him:

> *"@AnthonyCumia nothing but love and respect ant. Thanks for not selling your
> soul through this whole mess."* — **4 July 2014**

Three months earlier, on **25 March 2014**:

> *"@AnthonyCumia brilliant point re 'tranny' outrage. Minority groups feel
> entitled to have at least 1 term ruled a slur, offensive or otherwise"*

> **CONTRADICTION [2026-09-03]:** the 2022 account places Dan among those
> *"repulsed by the racism"* at the split. The contemporaneous record places
> him on the other side of it — congratulating Cumia on his integrity within
> twenty-four hours of a firing for racist posts, and endorsing his
> anti-political-correctness framing three months before. The year is
> spreadsheet-backed and contains no post expressing discomfort — supporting
> evidence, though the export is known to drop the occasional row, so **the
> contradiction rests on the two posts he made, not on the silence around
> them.**
>
> What this does **not** do is refute the 2022 claim outright. *"We were
> radicalized"* describes a process, and a process can start later than the
> event that eventually causes it. The precise correction is to the
> **timing**: whatever repulsion produced the 2020 turn, it had not begun by
> July 2014, and Dan's later account compresses a change of several years into
> a reaction to a single event. Recorded as **t015** in the testimony ledger,
> `partial`, failure mode `compression`, direction `early`, slant
> **`flattering`** — the first non-neutral slant in that ledger, and it is
> non-neutral in his own favour.
>
> The corpus is better with this in it. A conversion narrative that begins at
> the moment of the offence is a much smaller thing than one that begins with
> six more years of sitting inside the offence, and only the second one
> describes a person actually changing his mind.

**And it makes 2020 look more like the real date, not less.** If the split had
radicalised him in 2014, the six-year lag to the August 2020 self-narration
would need explaining. It does not: he was still in the audience.

## SLOPPP at full extension

2014 is where the project stops looking like a hobby with a good year and
starts looking like a small operation being run properly.

**Releases, and who they are for.** Official-style flips and remixes of named
artists throughout: RNDM VADER (2 January), SAYMYNAME (6 January), heRobust
(25 January), Katy Perry featuring Juicy J (27 January), gLAdiator's *Assembly
Line* (16 April), Drake × Cashmere Cat (9–12 May), Caked Up (3 August), Zeds
Dead's *Collapse* (24–30 October).

**Series, not one-offs.** *Week in TRAP* runs to at least episode 8 by
10 April. *Wax, Stacks and Racks* is a monthly wrap-up (*"the complete guide to
April 2014"*). *Heatwave Vol 1* opens a summer series on 14 May. And in
November a **video** show: *TRAP TV — sloppp live mix*, streamed on Ustream and
posted to YouTube (15–17 November), with a 4am broadcast on 8 December.

**Industry contact, in both directions.** He enters an official Beatport remix
contest with a Major Lazer flip and canvasses votes (22, 29 April). He sends
unsolicited tracks to another DJ twice (*"dm me your email and see what you
think"*, 17 April; *"I just emailed you some tracks"*, 26 April). He posts a
working collaboration address — **8 May**, *"Lets collab! danfr4nk@icloud.com
for stems and patch trades"*. He signs up to Splice (5 August). And he is
thanked *by* others: `@cobrakrames` (*"insane. thanks for the support!!"*),
`@whatdirt` (*"another enormous thank you for the support"*), a shout from Lil
Debbie (17 May). He also proposes a collaboration to `@Yamez1` and asks him for
a tracklist (26 April).

**Gear and cost.** A custom-painted MIDI controller finished on 1 December
(*"for max swaggery or some such shit"*). And a physical price twice recorded:
*"Early morning inversion table sesh"* (8 May) and, on **17 May**, *"So many
hours DJing that I need daily inversion table therapy fuck."*

**And the same self-cancelling reflex as 2013.** On 7 May: *"I only make deep
house now. EZ EZ"* — a genre pivot announced in four words, after which he goes
on making trap. On 18 November: *"Might change DJ alias to p4ssè for max
meta."*

## The Aoki objection, and what it says about him

On **25 April**, during the row about Steve Aoki's live shows:

> *"as a 'nobody' DJ, the aoki scandal is extra annoying. this is the kind
> nonsense that allows for EDM to be disregarded as mindless"*
> *"playing prerecorded mix is vile if the only other performance you're
> offering is spraying drinks on the hornswaggled (paying) audience/fans"*

Two things worth keeping. He classifies himself out loud — **"a 'nobody' DJ"**,
in the same month he was entering a Beatport contest and being thanked by other
producers, which is the on/off self-verdict again. And the objection is not
envy: it is that a famous performer is taking money from an audience for work
he is not doing. That is the same structure as every other target on
`wiki/mind/synthesis/vertical-authority-skepticism` — an authority whose claim
exceeds what it is delivering — applied here to his own field.

## Speculative unpaid work for a show he wanted into

Over **14–16 October**, Dan cut up the Chip kids-music segment from Opie &
Anthony into a reusable clip set, uploaded it to his own SoundCloud, and then
pitched it — in seven tweets across two days — to Jim Norton, Opie, Colin
Quinn, `@OpieandJimmy`, `@mondo270` and `@steveyknight`:

> *"i cut up the clips from the kids music break with chip today. it's a
> re-purposable goldmine"*
> *"Lets get Chip & his atrocious kid songs stuck in the head of children
> everywhere."*

Two years after the internship application of November 2012, and with no
recorded response to that either, he is doing production work for the show for
free and trying to get it noticed. It is a real skill, competently applied, at
an organisation that had not hired him.

## The next ambition, announced 19 December

> *"rap monument so fucking good that i want to start rapping"*
> *"srsly though i think my reference, pun, and pop culture games are heavy and
> could probably be some 2015 rap star kick"*

Nothing in the corpus follows it. It belongs beside the 2012 podcast proposed
to `@adamlucidi`, the 2012 blog, and the later video-essay project that still
has no artifact: a specific, plausible, self-assessed plan, stated publicly,
with no second post. The self-assessment inside it is accurate — the reference
and pun density on this page is genuinely high — which is what makes the
pattern worth naming rather than dismissing.

## He is still in Pennsylvania

**22 August**: *"Did I see the Uniontown bank robbery suspects today? Or am I a
self-absorbed, paranoid zilch? You decide."* — with a photograph. This
continues the presence 2013 establishes and pushes it a year further, inside
the window `wiki/self/location-history` records as having no address-level
data.

## Texture

Alexis is still here and the register is domestic (*"Keep filming me in my
sleep and I'll have to buy this"*, 28 April; *"so deep bro"*, 17 June). An hour
spent making *"Picasso style distortion edits on pictures of lil wayne"*
(30 April, hashtagged `#weezyfpicasso`). A great-grandmother identified as
*"the country club Queen Bee in 1960"* (27 May) — the second appearance of
"country club" as a family self-image, after the 2009 line. *"Starting a post
hardcore / Christian metalxcore band called 'Verb the Noun'"* (18 May).
*"Solipsism doesn't even seem that nutty anymore am I right?"* and *"My memoirs
are going to be called 'GO READ A BOOK OR SOMETHING'"*, both 5 December. And
several posts written entirely in decorative Unicode, which is the year's house
style.

## What would change this reading

If a live-scrape batch later adds 2014 posts expressing discomfort at the
firing, the Cumia contradiction softens from "he was on the other side" to "he
was on both sides", which is a different and more ordinary thing. That is a
live possibility rather than a formality: the export demonstrably missed at
least one tweet in 2016. It would not erase the 4 July post, but it would
change what the post means. The SLOPPP peak claim depends on 2015 and 2016
being genuinely quieter rather than differently archived; both are
spreadsheet-backed on the same basis as this year, so the comparison is sound
to the same degree and no further. And the ambition pattern
depends on absence — if a 2015 rap recording exists anywhere, the December
entry stops being an instance of it.
